summary: Move model API configuration from a modal into a fixed Settings section on the main CIRP page while preserving the existing security, budget and restart boundaries.
decision_refs: User request on 2026-09-27 to enter model API settings after opening the main page instead of using a separate popup
approval_evidence: The user explicitly requested the API entry UI inside the normal Settings page rather than a separate popup.
known_limitations: Only one model profile is active at a time.
Applying a different profile still requires an orderly same-port local service restart.
